notes:
Recurring problems, labelled per claim:
- LATEST. rowNumber = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gen_applicantidentitynumber ORDER BY gen_signaturedateofpowerofattorney DESC) (DTSX:26931). A window ORDER BY cannot see the SELECT alias of the same level, so it binds to the raw column, not to the alias convert(date, DATEADD(hour,3,isnull(gen_signaturedateofpowerofattorney, gen_signaturedate))) (DTSX:26954). The ranking ignores the gen_signaturedate fallback that the population filter uses (DTSX:26987). A NULL POA signature date ranks last (DESC). Ties are arbitrary. The partition covers all POA types fetched.
- NOAGENT. On the PJ Match path, NULL agent/agency become Guid.Empty (Check If Poa Attached main.cs:52-53, DTSX:31595; CreatePOARows DTSX:31640), so the Create POA Main guard (main.cs:327, DTSX:34169) does not stop those rows.
- OWN. Ownership of unqualified columns in multi-table queries is stated without the ownership argument that the standard requires.
- Confirmed by re-derivation: the precedence chain (DTSX:45650-45663, all Success); disabled flags; the AJ and PJ path topology; the lookup SQL and parameter maps (DTSX:22205, 22026, 21620, 21816, 27982, 36518, 31273); the period-merge code (main.cs:117-136); create attributes for AJ (main.cs:167-264) and PJ (main.cs:146-265); the update scripts; the SQL update of gen_pensionjoiningbase (DTSX:36944); cross-package references 0027:1371/5936, 0006:9752, 0012:100190, 0033:15, 0031:40447-40453/31302, 0030:6661, 0028:8053-8058.

results.detail: Check If POA Of Customer Account Exists (DTSX:22176) has no path from its Match Output.
